title: 状语从句与条件句
goal: 能按逻辑关系排列状语从句，并区分真实与非真实条件的时态。
exam: TOEFL iBT（2026 年 1 月起的新版）· 写作

points.label: 按条件句的时态配合选择词块

body.p: 状语从句说明原因、让步、时间或条件。两个分句是什么关系，由连接词决定。每个分句一般都有自己的主语和谓语。主句和从句的先后可以调换，意思不变。

body.box:
Because the pipe leaked, the technician stopped the test.
The technician stopped the test because the pipe leaked.

body.p: 条件句用时态表示事情有多大可能。If the pipe leaks, we will stop the test 表示将来可能漏水。If the pipe leaked, we would stop the test 是假设，这里的过去式不表示已经漏水。

cards.title: 状语从句的关系
rows: because
说明原因，后接分句。because of 后接名词。
We stopped because the pipe leaked. / We stopped because of a leak.
although
引出让步。主句前不再加 but。
Although the pipe was new, it leaked.
when
表示时间，可指一次事件或一般情况。
When the alarm sounds, the valve closes.
until
用在肯定句里，表示动作一直持续到某个时候。
We waited until the pipe cooled.
not … until
表示某动作直到某时才发生。
We did not restart until the pipe cooled.
as soon as
表示一件事发生后另一件事随即发生。
We restarted as soon as the inspection ended.

cards.title: 分句位置与时态
rows: 从句在前
从句和主句之间一般加逗号。
When the test ended, the technician left.
从句在后
时间或原因从句放在后面，一般不加逗号。
The technician left when the test ended.
将来的时间从句
表示将来的事用一般现在时，不用 will。
We will leave as soon as the test ends.
将来之前完成
强调事情先完成，从句用现在完成时。
We will leave when the test has ended.
过去事件
过去发生的事，从句用过去时。
We left when the test ended.
when 的两种作用
时间从句用现在时。问未知时间的间接问句可以用 will。
We will leave when it ends. / We do not know when it will end.

cards.title: 条件句的时态配合
rows: 一般事实
if 从句和主句都用一般现在时。
If the sensor fails, the warning light comes on.
真实的未来条件
if 从句用现在时，主句用 will + 原形。
If the sensor fails, we will replace it.
真实条件与指令
主句也可以用情态动词或祈使句。
If the light comes on, stop the test.
现在或将来非真实条件
if 用过去式，主句用 would / could + 原形。
If we had a spare sensor, we could continue.
非真实 be
正式写法用 were，口语里也用 was。
If the sensor were reliable, we would use it.
过去非真实条件
if 用过去完成时，主句用 would have + 过去分词。
If we had checked the sensor, we would have noticed the fault.
if 从句里的 would
假设的结果用 would，放在主句。if 从句里的 would 表示意愿。
If the sensor failed, we would stop. / If the operator would help, we could finish.

body.box:
There is no spare filter, so the trial cannot continue.
If we ______ ______ ______ ______ the trial.
a spare filter, / had / continue / we could / have

body.p: 前一句说目前没有备用滤芯，所以 if 从句是与现状相反的假设，用 had。主句用 could continue。could 放在主句，不放进 if 从句。

body.box: If we had a spare filter, we could continue the trial.

body.p: a spare filter, 末尾的逗号表示从句到此结束。have 是现在时，不能用在这个非真实条件句里。

items.stem: Why did the temperature reading disappear?
items.why: because 后接完整的分句 the battery was empty。battery 是单数，用 was，were 是多出的词块。

items.stem: Did the new seal prevent the leak?
items.why: Although 引出让步，从句结束后直接接主句 it leaked，不再加 but。

items.stem: When should the timer start?
items.why: when 后接主语 the green light 和谓语 appears。light 是单数，动词加 -s。

items.stem: Can the lid be opened now?
items.why: until 后接 the pressure has fallen，表示等到压力降下来。has 后接过去分词 fallen。

items.stem: The backup motor is available if this one fails.
items.why: 故障将来可能真的发生，从句用 fails，主句用 will replace it。failing 不能单独作从句的谓语。

items.stem: We have no insulated container, so the samples cannot be transported.
items.why: 题干说没有容器，所以用 had 和 could transport 表示与现状相反的假设。主语 we 不用 has。

items.stem: The warning was ignored, and the pump was damaged.
items.why: 过去没有发生的事，条件用 had noticed，结果用 would have stopped。had 后面不接原形 notice。

items.stem: The chamber is too small for the test.
items.why: were larger 是与实际尺寸相反的假设，与 could run 配合。be larger 不能单独作从句的谓语。

items.stem: When should the recorder be switched off?
items.lead: Switch it off as soon as
items.why: as soon as 引出将来的时间从句，用现在时 ends，不用 will end。

items.stem: Why did the reading remain uncertain?
items.lead: We did not confirm it until
items.why: not … until 表示第二次测量结果到了才确认。过去的事用 arrived。

items.stem: The coolant level may drop during the trial.
items.why: drops 和 will sound 构成真实的未来条件。dropping 不能单独作 if 从句的谓语。

items.stem: The instrument was not calibrated, so the results were unusable.
items.why: had been calibrated 是过去完成时的被动，主句用 would have been。had was calibrated 不成立。

items.stem: Why did the density trial stop?
items.why: because 引出试验停止的原因。the sample jar 是单数，用 was cracked。

items.stem: Did the reinforced hinge remain intact?
items.why: Although 引出让步 the hinge was reinforced。主句 it broke 前不再加 but。

items.stem: When should the diffraction image be saved?
items.why: when 引出将来的时间从句，用现在时 finishes，不用 will finish。

items.stem: Can the sealed vessel be moved immediately?
items.why: until 说明要等到什么时候才能移动。将来的时间从句用现在时 falls。

items.stem: When should the flow measurement begin?
items.why: as soon as 表示阀门一打开就开始。时间从句用现在时 opens。

items.stem: The controller can replace a failed fuse automatically.
items.why: 真实的未来条件，从句用 fails，主句用 will replace it。failing 不能单独作从句的谓语。

items.stem: There is no vacuum chamber, so the experiment cannot proceed.
items.why: 题干说没有真空室，条件与现状相反，用 had，与 could proceed 配合。主语 we 不用 has。

items.stem: The microscope is not powerful enough to reveal the detail.
items.why: were stronger 是非真实条件，主句用 could see。be stronger 不能单独作从句的谓语。

items.stem: The vibration was not detected, and the test was not stopped.
items.why: 过去未发生的条件用 had detected，未实现的结果用 would have stopped。

items.stem: The humidity data were not saved, so the analysis was delayed.
items.why: had been saved 和 would not have been delayed 构成过去的非真实条件。had were saved 不成立。
